subtitulo: Web interfaces, UX/UI and digital experiences
presentacion: Junior web developer with technical training (a two-year web development degree and a full stack bootcamp) and work experience in web companies. I build interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Astro and React, making sure they are accessible and easy to use.

sobreMiTitulo: Training and experience in web development.
sobreMi: My first web job was in 2019, maintaining pages and content at Wonka Producciones, the same year I earned the official certificate in Web Application Development. I then trained as a Microcomputer Systems and Networks Technician and as a Higher Technician in Web Application Development.

I have worked with WordPress, Divi, Elementor, SEO and content at Web Las Palmas and Etnonautas, and in 2026 I completed Ironhack's Full Stack + AI bootcamp with FULP. I now work at Qraneos on a work-study training contract: coding katas, web scraping with TypeScript and technical documentation, in a team using Git, GitLab and Jira.
I also have training and experience in graphic design, which helps me take care of the visual side of interfaces.
busco: I have technical training and experience in web development companies, and I am looking for a junior frontend developer role in a team where design and user experience matter.
